note: Five web functions split along seams they already had: decodeStringLiteral (numeric and octal escape decoding hoisted out of the tokenizer loop), formatAST (operator and collection node families separated, with the shared binding-power parenthesization factored out), debounce (executeAndSettle and the leading/trailing edge normalization hoisted to module scope), parseTime (the no-separator digit-run sub-parser, the component parser and the range validation extracted), scrollTo (the scroll-and-settle helper and its scrollend/rAF settle detection hoisted). 57 -> 52.
